output.title: Comment-only fix listed under Documentation, no runtime effect
output.content: The release notes list this change (#7620) under the v1.18.0 Documentation section, and its only description is "Fix some comments". Nothing in the excerpt mentions a Helm values key, an API version, a CRD, an image or any behaviour, so it has no clear link to this environment's settings (for example replicaCount, webhook.timeoutSeconds or prometheus.servicemonitor.*) or to the cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate resources. If the operator wants to be sure, they can open PR #7620 and confirm it only changes comments.
